name: Airbnb's journey
summary: Seventeen years of Airbnb launches on one timeline, each tagged by the kind of innovation it was and by what triggered it. Filter by type or trigger and the pattern shows itself: the radical moves are rare and early, and the launches people remember came from responding to a need.
steps: Open the timeline. It runs top to bottom from the first guests in 2007 to the 2024 winter release.
Tap an innovation type (radical, incremental, partnership and so on) to dim everything else. Tap several to combine.
Tap a trigger to see only the launches that followed a human need, a business opportunity, or neither.
Each row reads left to right: what happened, what Airbnb did about it, what came of it. Show all resets the filters.
Prefer the original? The map I drew in draw.io is linked at the top of the timeline, as an SVG you can zoom and a .drawio file you can edit.
